canonical_byte_and_cid_vectors.full_corpus_coverage: Four raw-byte vectors cover empty, ASCII, UTF-8, and embedded-NUL/binary input. Eleven structured vectors cover null, booleans, signed integers, empty containers, key-order independence, nested Unicode, and heterogeneous reviewed lists. Every vector carries Python and JavaScript instructions plus a CIDv1/base32/sha2-256/codec binding.

positive_coverage: raw source bytes produce fixed CIDv1/base32/raw/sha2-256 anchors
structured maps produce sorted compact UTF-8 canonical bytes and a fixed dag-json CID anchor
